1. git checkout main
2. git pull --ff-only origin main
3. git fetch origin main
4. git rebase origin/main on the feature branch
5. gh pr create --base main --head feature/WF02-dsl09-20260527 --title "feat(WF02-dsl09-20260527): implement DSL-09 date built-ins" --body "DSL-09: now(), date_add(), date_diff() with cross-DST boundary test"

Record branch_name, commit_sha_list, pr_url (or pr_create_error), push_status in result.
